note: Print areas for the art line. A product is `verified: true` only when its print area AND resolution rule were read from the print provider's own pages on `checkedOn` (see `source`). Everything else is `verified: false`: usable for planning and mockups, but confirm against the provider's File guidelines template before selling. Providers change templates; re-check when a store is chosen (plan Phase 8).

products.label: T-shirt (front print)
products.sourceNote: Printful: standard DTG print area 12 x 16 in; files at least 150 DPI and no higher than 300. Printful is moving some products to 15 x 18 in — check the product's File guidelines tab.
products.styleNotes: Bold shapes and strong contrast read best. Fine detail and small text soften on fabric. Art needs a transparent background; a rectangular block prints as a rectangle.

products.label: Hoodie (front print)
products.sourceNote: Resolution rule (150-300 DPI) is Printful's. The 12 x 16 in area is assumed from the standard DTG area; hoodie fronts are often shorter because of the pocket. NOT confirmed for any specific hoodie.
products.styleNotes: As for t-shirts. Keep the art above the pocket line.

products.label: Dad hat (front)
products.sourceNote: Printful gives dad-hat front logos as 3.5-4 in wide and about 1.75-2 in tall. Those are embroidery/logo areas in inches; the pixel size here is that area at an assumed 300 DPI, not a provider print template. Embroidery also needs simplified art and a digitizing step.
products.styleNotes: Very small, wide area. Only simple, bold marks or short words survive. Detailed collage art does not; expect the Strategist to skip most full designs here or use a cropped motif.

products.label: Poster 18 x 24 in
products.sourceNote: Printful: 300 DPI is the ideal poster and canvas resolution (general rule 150-300 DPI) — that rule was read from the source page. 18 x 24 in is a standard poster size and the pixel size is that size at 300 DPI; it was not read from a specific product's template, and bleed is not included.
products.styleNotes: Full-bleed art works well. Portrait 3:4. The whole design is seen at once, so detailed collage and texture read fully.

products.label: Poster 12 x 16 in
products.sourceNote: Printful: 300 DPI is the ideal poster and canvas resolution (general rule 150-300 DPI) — that rule was read from the source page. 12 x 16 in is a standard poster size and the pixel size is that size at 300 DPI; it was not read from a specific product's template, and bleed is not included.
products.styleNotes: As for the larger poster; a lower-priced size for smaller source files.

products.label: Sticker 4 x 4 in
products.sourceNote: Printful states stickers need 300 DPI. The 4 x 4 in size is a common sticker size, not read from a specific product template.
products.styleNotes: A single strong motif with a clear silhouette. Kiss-cut follows the art's outline.

products.label: Phone case
products.sourceNote: Printful states phone cases need 300 DPI. Case dimensions differ for every phone model; this is a generic tall area for planning and mockups only.
products.styleNotes: Tall and narrow, with a camera cut-out near the top. Full-bleed art; keep the subject in the lower two thirds.

products.label: Single / album cover (digital)
products.sourceNote: 3000 x 3000 px is the size music distributors commonly ask for. Not read from a distributor's own page; confirm with the distributor the buyer uses.
products.styleNotes: Square. Must read at thumbnail size on a phone. A digital product: nothing is printed, so the dpi figure only sets how far the art may be enlarged.

products.label: Phone wallpaper (digital)
products.sourceNote: 1080 x 1920 px (9:16) is a common phone screen size, chosen for planning. Not a provider spec.
products.styleNotes: 9:16 portrait. Leave the top quarter calm for the clock and the bottom for the dock.
